'''Robert Silmser''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 44 from Tampa/Brandon, FL.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He played with his son and daughters in Tampa and Brandon, Florida.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
